subject.title: California Supreme Court — Retain Justice Joshua Groban

text: Associate Justice, Supreme Court of California
Harvard Law School, J.D., 1998; Stanford University, A.B., 1995.

Law Clerk to Judge William C. Conner, Southern District of New York, 1998–1999; Attorney, Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton & Garrison LLP, 1999–2005; Attorney, Munger, Tolles & Olson LLP, 2005–2010; Senior Advisor to Governor Jerry Brown, 2011–2018; Lecturer, UCLA School of Law, 2014–2018.
Associate Justice, Supreme Court of California, 2018–present.
